questions.text: How many days do I have to return an item?

evidence.excerpt: Most items can be returned within 45 days of delivery.

questions.text: Do top-tier loyalty members get more time to send things back?

evidence.excerpt: Members of the Trailmark loyalty program at the Summit tier get an extended window of 90 days.

questions.text: Can I return something with a red Final Sale tag?

evidence.excerpt: Items bought during the winter clearance event, marked with a red "Final Sale" tag, cannot be returned at all.

questions.text: Can I bring back hiking shoes I already wore outside?

evidence.excerpt: Footwear that has been worn outdoors can still be returned if it shows no more wear than a short walk would cause.

questions.text: What has to come back with a tent I am returning?

evidence.excerpt: Tents must be returned with every pole, stake and guy line that came in the box.

questions.text: Why will the shop refuse a camping stove that still has gas in it?

evidence.excerpt: we cannot accept any item that still contains gas or liquid fuel, for safety reasons

questions.text: What does an RMA number look like?

evidence.excerpt: the number always begins with the letters RMA followed by eight digits, for example RMA-20481937

questions.text: What happens to a parcel sent back without the authorization number?

evidence.excerpt: Parcels that arrive without this number are refused by the warehouse and sent back to the sender.

questions.text: How long until a card refund shows up on my statement?

evidence.excerpt: Card refunds appear on the statement within 5 to 7 business days after the warehouse inspects the parcel.

questions.text: I paid with a gift card. How am I refunded?

evidence.excerpt: Gift card purchases are refunded as a new digital gift card, issued the same day.

questions.text: Will you give me back the delivery cost if the product arrived broken?

evidence.excerpt: The original shipping fee is not refunded, except when the product was defective or we sent the wrong item.

questions.text: How long is the replacement size held during an exchange?

evidence.excerpt: We reserve the replacement for 10 days while the original item travels back to us.

questions.text: How much does standard delivery cost?

evidence.excerpt: Standard delivery takes three to five business days and costs 6.90 per order.

questions.text: From what order value is shipping free?

evidence.excerpt: Orders above 120 ship for free with standard delivery.

questions.text: What is the cut-off time to get my parcel tomorrow?

evidence.excerpt: Express delivery arrives on the next business day for orders placed before 13:00 local time

questions.text: How long does a shop keep an order I chose to collect myself?

evidence.excerpt: the shop keeps it for 7 days before cancelling it

questions.text: Do deliveries to the islands take longer?

evidence.excerpt: island deliveries take two extra days

questions.text: Who pays import taxes on orders sent abroad?

evidence.excerpt: Duties and import taxes on international orders are paid by the customer when the parcel is delivered.

questions.text: Can gas canisters be sent by plane?

evidence.excerpt: We do not ship stove fuel canisters by air.

questions.text: How is a kayak delivered and how much does it cost?

evidence.excerpt: Freight delivery takes 7 to 12 business days and costs a flat 39.

questions.text: My parcel says delivered but I can't find it. What should I do?

evidence.excerpt: customers should wait 24 hours, check with neighbours, and then contact support

questions.text: How soon must I report a box that arrived crushed?

evidence.excerpt: Parcels damaged in transit must be reported within 48 hours of delivery

questions.text: How long is the legal warranty?

evidence.excerpt: All products sold by Kestrel & Fern carry a two-year legal warranty against manufacturing defects.

questions.text: Is there a lifetime guarantee on Fernline zippers?

evidence.excerpt: Our own brand, Fernline, adds a lifetime guarantee on stitching and zippers for as long as the original buyer owns the product.

questions.text: Is a jacket whose waterproofing wore off after years covered?

evidence.excerpt: Faded colours and worn-out waterproof coatings after years of use are considered normal wear.

questions.text: Who decides whether a defect is covered and how long does it take?

evidence.excerpt: The repair workshop in Lisbon decides within 10 business days whether the defect is covered.

questions.text: When do I get my money back instead of a fix under warranty?

evidence.excerpt: A refund is only offered when neither a repair nor a replacement is possible.

questions.text: How much does it cost to resole hiking boots?

evidence.excerpt: Resoling hiking boots: 55 per pair

questions.text: What is the price of a new tent pole section?

evidence.excerpt: Replacing a broken tent pole section: 12

questions.text: When does the workshop start a paid repair?

evidence.excerpt: Customers receive a quote by e-mail and the work only starts after they accept it.

questions.text: Why does fixing a down jacket take an extra week?

evidence.excerpt: Down jackets and sleeping bags are cleaned before any repair, at no extra cost, because feathers cannot be sewn safely when they are dirty.

questions.text: How many points do I get per euro?

evidence.excerpt: Members earn one point for every euro spent.

questions.text: Do I earn points when I buy a gift card?

evidence.excerpt: Points are not earned on gift cards, shipping fees or repair services.

questions.text: Why can't I use my points right after buying?

evidence.excerpt: Points become available 30 days after the purchase, once the return window for most items has passed.

questions.text: When do loyalty points expire?

evidence.excerpt: Points expire 24 months after they were earned if the member makes no purchase in that period.

questions.text: What do I need to reach the Ridge tier?

evidence.excerpt: | Ridge | 500 – 1,499 | Free standard delivery on every order |

questions.text: How often is my membership level updated?

evidence.excerpt: The tier is recalculated on the first day of every month based on the points earned in the previous 12 months.

questions.text: How many points make a 10 voucher?

evidence.excerpt: Every 200 points can be exchanged for a voucher worth 10.

questions.text: Can I give my points to my partner?

evidence.excerpt: they cannot be transferred to another member, except between two accounts registered at the same home address

questions.text: Should I use fabric softener on a rain jacket?

evidence.excerpt: never with fabric softener, which blocks the pores of the membrane

questions.text: How do I bring back the water repellency of my jacket?

evidence.excerpt: Restore it with a spray-on proofer, applied to the clean, damp jacket.

questions.text: I had to pack my tent in the rain. What now?

evidence.excerpt: If it must be packed in the rain, set it up again within 24 hours to dry it completely

questions.text: How do I set up the poles of the KF-RB2?

evidence.excerpt: Its poles should be assembled from the middle outward to avoid stress on the shock cord.

questions.text: How should a sleeping bag be stored between trips?

evidence.excerpt: Store sleeping bags loosely in the large cotton storage sack, never compressed in the stuff sack

questions.text: Why put tennis balls in the dryer with a down bag?

evidence.excerpt: must be dried with two or three tennis balls to break up the clumps

questions.text: Can I dry wet boots next to the fireplace?

evidence.excerpt: Direct heat cracks the leather and weakens the glue between the sole and the upper.

questions.text: What time do stores open on Sundays?

evidence.excerpt: from 11:00 to 18:00 on Sundays

questions.text: Up to what amount can a sales assistant approve a return alone?

evidence.excerpt: Staff can approve returns up to a value of 300 on their own.

questions.text: When must a rental climbing rope be taken out of service?

evidence.excerpt: retired after 50 rental days or immediately after any fall that loaded the rope

questions.text: What discount do employees get on Fernline gear?

evidence.excerpt: Employees receive a 30% discount on all products, and 40% on Fernline products, for personal use.

questions.text: Can I split my payment into several months?

evidence.excerpt: Orders above 200 can be paid in three monthly instalments without interest when paying with a credit card on our website.

questions.text: Until when can I cancel an order?

evidence.excerpt: Orders can be changed or cancelled within one hour of being placed.
